lines.text: Many learners say: We walked to home.
Home! They ran home after school.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «مشينا إلى البيت»، أما home بعد أفعال الحركة فلا تحتاج إلى to: “We walked home.” وليس “We walked to home”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “We walked to home.” 😅 كلمة home بعد أفعال الحركة لا تحتاج إلى to، فالجملة الصحيحة “We walked home.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “We walked to home”?
en.tip: After a verb of movement, home needs no to: “We walked home.” not “We walked to home”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “We walked to home.” 😅 In English home needs no to, so the right sentence is “We walked home.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
